title: Bends and ends.
officialText:
Tolerance for longitudinal location of bends and ends of reinforcement shall be ± 2 inches (±
51 mm) except the tolerance shall be ± 1/ inch (± 12.7 mm) at the discontinuous ends of brackets and corbels, and ± 1 inch
2
(25 mm) at the discontinuous ends of other members. The tolerance for concrete cover of Section 1907.5.2.1 shall also
apply at discontinuous ends of members.
